newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sampoerna says 1996 cigarette sales up.
newsitem.headline: Sampoerna says 1996 cigarette sales up.

text.p: Indonesian cigarette maker PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna said on Tuesday it had 1996 cigarette sales of 2.14 trillion rupiah against 1.64 trillion rupiah in 1995.
The company said it sold a total of 22.2 billion "sticks" -- cigarettes -- in 1996, against 17.80 billion in 1995.
It said the company had cigarette sales of 596.01 billion rupiah in the fourth quarter of 1996, against 461.88 billion rupiah in the same period of 1995.
Sampoerna said it sold a total of 5.64 billion sticks in the fourth quarter of 1996, compared with 5.04 billion sticks in the same period in 1995.
